adapter_policy: The rendered units of the story's prerender as a table module of the project database intermediary (qnc-db-broker): prerender_units (fingerprint, file URI, frames, samples, encoder) and the view public_prerender_units. A unit counts as rendered only when it is here (the project folder denies deleting, so a file of an interrupted render can stay). It owns only its table and is written only through the intermediary.
